name: Career changer new to tech events
whoTheyAre: Someone in a job or career transition who's showing up at tech community events for the first time, often unsure they belong.
whatTheyGet: A place to build skills with other people, work they can point to, and people who've seen what they can do.
theAsk: Come to one workshop. It's free, hands-on, and starts from zero.
whereToFind: Transition programs for federal and fed-adjacent workers
